title: This closely-watched guru just sold everything
html:
Brett Arends's ROI

Opinion: This closely-watched guru just sold everything

Panmure Liberum strategist and widely-followed stock market commentator Joachim Klement has effectively had his personal retirement portfolio 100% invested in stocks for many years.

This morning he sold everything.
summary: Panmure Liberum strategist and widely-followed stock-market commentator Joachim Klement has effectively had his personal retirement portfolio 100% invested in stocks for many years.
